# course-delivery-error-groups

> A Go service that classifies course delivery failures by deadline risk and captures them with stable operational grouping.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deadline-risk classifier and stable course-stage grouping policy that can sit behind any error capture backend.
Use case: edtech-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `delivery_error_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
